summary: Clamps a short[4] rectangle (x1=this+0x0, y1=this+0x2, width=this+0x4, height=this+0x6) in-place so it stays inside the boundary given by min (a2, a3) and max (a2+a4, a3+a5). When a corner moves inward the affected dimension shrinks; the right/bottom edges are additionally clamped to the bound, and the function returns the bottom bound.

Clip the left edge: if x1 (this+0x0) < a2, reduce width (this+0x4) by (a2 - x1) and set x1 = a2.
Clamp the right edge: if x1 + width + 1 (this+0x0 + this+0x4 + 1) exceeds a2 + a4 + 1, set width (this+0x4) to (a2 + a4 + 1) - x1.
Clamp the bottom edge: if y1 + height (this+0x2 + this+0x6) exceeds a3 + a5, set height (this+0x6) to (a3 + a5) - y1.
Return the bottom bound a3 + a5, already reduced to (a3 + a5) - y1 when the bottom edge was clamped.
